selection_basis: First recorded metadata row in a different repository from exposed Polly, Serilog, RestSharp, Autofac and CsvHelper. No problem statement, reference patch, hidden test, label or outcome used to choose this identity.
evaluation_question: Can genuine B choose investigation, targets and experiments, revise from public observations and deliver under current v2; if qualifying public information gain occurs, does the ordered normal terminal extraction produce a conditional strategy?
expected_effect: A different source task avoids same-problem retries; ordered public experience may improve the factual basis of extraction, but effectiveness remains unknown.
comparison_baseline: No comparable task baseline exists yet. Prior two retained extraction outputs were unsuitable; do not attribute any new task result causally to input organization.
preparation_scope: Project exact pinned retained dataset row into public requirement and separate evaluator-only material; acquire only fixed source; inspect required SDK and existing caches; qualify public reproduction and independent evaluator before any new model attempt.
resource_policy: meter_only; ordinary local experimental resource renewal is not required. New attempts keep their own clocks and costs; no ended attempt allowance is transferred. No model or build launched by task opening.

source_acquisition_phase.downloads: one pinned source archive, not model weights or images
source_acquisition_phase.why: 为什么要有它：这是本次源码取得的有限工程保护，不恢复已取消的一般实验人工续批或8GiB门槛。

public_input_boundary: Public problem and baseline/public reproduction only; never copy reference patch, hidden tests/labels or outside repair analysis into solver or extraction input.
return_point: After source and evaluator readiness, register/freeze one real task attempt and continue remaining U1-U5 work. No automatic repeat, no required success on old tasks, no automatic B+ admission of unsuitable strategies.
why: 为什么要有它：先固定来源和待回答问题，准备过程也必须保留曝光及成本边界，不能按答案挑题或把环境验证算自主成绩。
